name: pdk-tracim-search-index-consistency
instr:
# Content search consistency

## Background

Provide safe content search for space members while documents move, workers lag, and indices are rotated. Tracim feeds Elasticsearch through the web app and RQ indexer.

## Proposal

Make content search a safe projection of committed content and current permissions during normal operation and online rotations. 

## Requirements

- Committed HTML documents and edits become searchable to space members by current title and body within 65 seconds of dependency recovery; an older title or body must not replace the latest revision, even with out-of-order workers.
- After a move from space A to space B, A-only members cannot find the document, its title, body or facets, even before Elasticsearch receives the move. Members of B can find it when indexed. Search results and hit counts must reflect current database access, not stale indexed workspace IDs.
- A hard-purged document is absent from search forever, including after an already-running write completes or Elasticsearch's delete retention expires.
- Edits committed while Redis cannot accept work or Elasticsearch cannot accept writes are retained across web or worker restarts, and become searchable without a full reindex after the services recover. Web writes remain available while those dependencies are unavailable.
- `tracimcli search index-upgrade-experimental` completes while creates, edits, moves and purges continue; after the alias switch the new index reflects all committed chang
